LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing 3.1 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Orthography • Handwriting(spelling) By t
Topic 3.2: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing 3.1 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Orthography • Handwriting(spelling) By t in Grade 8 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: What strategies can you use to write effectively?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to a dictation and list vocabulary related to members of the extended family,

2. trace words and phrases of members of the extended family in Chinese (e.g. 叔叔 Shūshu , 姑姑 Gūgu, 舅舅 Jiùjiu, 阿姨 Āyí, 堂弟 Tángdì, 表妹 Biǎomèi , 姐夫 Jiěfū, 嫂 子 Sǎo zǐ etc.),

3. match pictures of professions with corresponding names collaboratively,

4. rearrange jumbled up words to make correct sentences on descriptions of members of the extended family by their name, age and profession collaboratively (e.g. 我姑姑是护 士;她今年 30 岁,她叫玛丽。),

5. write sentences describing one member of their extended family by their name, age and profession,

6. discuss areas of difficulty in writing Chinese characters and pinyin and give practical interventions.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to a dictation and list vocabulary related to members of the extended family,
2. trace words and phrases of members of the extended family in Chinese (e.g. 叔叔 Shūshu , 姑姑 Gūgu, 舅舅 Jiùjiu, 阿姨 Āyí, 堂弟 Tángdì, 表妹 Biǎomèi , 姐夫 Jiěfū, 嫂 子 Sǎo zǐ etc.),
3. match pictures of professions with corresponding names collaboratively,
4. rearrange jumbled up words to make correct sentences on descriptions of members of the extended family by their name, age and profession collaboratively (e.g. 我姑姑是护 士;她今年 30 岁,她叫玛丽。),
5. write sentences describing one member of their extended family by their name, age and profession,
6. discuss areas of difficulty in writing Chinese characters and pinyin and give practical interventions.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Self-efficacy: the learner develops an awareness of who they are, as well as their family members and their professions as they

make descriptions of extended family members.

Values:
Unity: the learner collaborates with peers to carry out class activities as they rearrange jumbled up words to make correct

sentences on descriptions of members of the extended family.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion is portrayed as the learner conducts a brief introduction/description of their extended family members, creating

awareness of family ties.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the skills used in articulating one’s thoughts and ideas logically in writing to English and Kiswahili.
